input.goal: Maintain health with tolerable risk, improve personal and shared life, understand unknowns, develop reusable abilities and honor freely accepted commitments. Choose, revise, pause or abandon your own projects using actual evidence. No specific invention or social arrangement is required.

interfaces.name: Navigate
interfaces.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
interfaces.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
interfaces.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Rest
interfaces.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
interfaces.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Wait
interfaces.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Pick up
interfaces.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
interfaces.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Eat
interfaces.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Gather accessible material
interfaces.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
interfaces.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
interfaces.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Drop
interfaces.function: Place owned units on the ground.
interfaces.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Give
interfaces.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
interfaces.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Message
interfaces.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
interfaces.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Learn a public interface
interfaces.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
interfaces.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
interfaces.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: Request a capability
interfaces.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
interfaces.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
interfaces.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

interfaces.name: probe
interfaces.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
interfaces.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
interfaces.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

interfaces.name: consult
interfaces.function: Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
interfaces.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
interfaces.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

interfaces.name: exchange
interfaces.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
interfaces.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
interfaces.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

execution.progress: One complete low-cost interaction; repetition performs a new interaction with its actual costs.

interfaces.name: council
interfaces.function: Report personal findings, read shared records or independently respond at the group meeting location.
interfaces.costs: One round and 0.2 energy. Actual local presence is required.
interfaces.effects: Dated information or a voluntary response only; no free goods, mastery or reward.

execution.progress: One actual communication per complete execution.

interfaces.name: teach
interfaces.function: Offer a personally mastered ability to a nearby participant, or accept an actual offer before individual study.
interfaces.costs: One round and 0.2 energy. Actual local presence is required.
interfaces.effects: Dated information or a voluntary response only; no free goods, mastery or reward.

execution.progress: One actual communication per complete execution.

payload.recordAccess: Omitted personal records remain retained: consult project/knowledge with an ID or page:N. Current-world capability discovery uses consult ability page:N at the meeting location, or actual nearby teaching. Individual mastery still requires learning. Capability contracts shown below are executable interfaces, not recommendations.

shown.function: Create an oriented traversable 2 by 2 roof with three physical posts from actual branches, vines and bark; use, repair and dismantle its persistent components.

members.name: Birch 1
members.intention: Establish a food reserve and inspect existing capabilities before requesting new ones.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and discover available reusable capabilities.
personalIntent.reason: Known safe roots are nearby; the capability catalogue is accessible at the meeting location.
personalIntent.progress: Healthy, with no carried food or additional capabilities discovered.
personalIntent.next: Gather a small reserve, then consult the capability index.

shown: Roots provide 14 nutrition with zero known toxicity; gathering does not imply regeneration.

shown.description: Arrived after traveling 0.441 distance; spent 0.882 energy.

members.name: Birch 2
members.intention: Maintain a safe reserve while surveying nearby materials.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and inspect a nearby material source.
personalIntent.reason: A branch-bearing tree is visible, but its material properties have not been tested.
personalIntent.next: Collect roots, recover effort, then observe the tree.

shown: The visible tree currently holds nine branch units; their useful properties remain unknown.

shown.description: Arrived after traveling 0.441 distance; spent 0.882 energy.

members.name: Birch 3
members.intention: Inspect the actual food source without assuming renewable yield.

personalIntent.goal: Maintain food security and learn about a local food source.
personalIntent.reason: Roots are known safe, but the observed finite stock does not establish future supply.
personalIntent.progress: No roots gathered or source tests performed.
personalIntent.next: Gather a modest reserve and observe the root plant.

shown: The root plant starts with six units on ordinary moist soil.

shown.description: Arrived after traveling 0.441 distance; spent 0.882 energy.

members.name: Birch 4
members.intention: Explore practical protection without assuming materials or construction skill.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and investigate protection from outdoor exposure.
personalIntent.reason: Currently outdoors with wind and rain; no shelter capability is known.
personalIntent.progress: Healthy; no shelter or building materials acquired.
personalIntent.next: Gather roots, recover energy, and request a feasible protection capability.

shown: Current outdoor exposure is observed; severe weather injury has not occurred.

shown.description: Arrived after traveling 0.441 distance; spent 0.882 energy.

members.name: Birch 5
members.intention: Inspect my actual food reserve using its explicit item identity.

personalIntent.goal: Maintain safe food supplies and learn the condition of carried roots.
personalIntent.reason: Three roots are already owned, but storage lifetime is unknown; the previous inspection failed because its reference was ambiguous.
personalIntent.progress: Gathered three roots and recovered energy to 40. Health is 100 and satiety is 75.5. No food inspection has succeeded.
personalIntent.next: Observe the explicitly identified carried root stack and review the findings before choosing storage or processing work.

shown: At tick 5 I own three roots harvested at tick 3; their displayed decay is 2.75454271, but its practical meaning is not established.
Roots have known nutrition 14 and toxicity 0. Food does not heal.

shown.description: Arrived after traveling 0.441 distance; spent 0.882 energy.

members.name: Birch 6
members.intention: Explore a short distance with safe food in reserve.

personalIntent.goal: Secure food and cautiously survey the nearby eastern edge.
personalIntent.reason: Nearby eastern terrain differs from the forest, with no identified local hazards so far.
personalIntent.progress: Healthy; no carried supplies or travel underway.
personalIntent.next: Gather roots, recover effort, and make a short local survey.

shown: This is a short survey, not a commitment to distant travel.

shown.description: Arrived after traveling 0.441 distance; spent 0.882 energy.
